# Store the file content and parse song titles
fs_file = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path="~/documents/personal/old_songs.txt", access_token=fs_token)
content = fs_file['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line "# Archived Songs"
song_entries = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        # Remove leading "- "
        entry = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence? but title may contain " by "? assume first " by " separates)
        # Actually format: "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        # We'll split on " by " but there might be multiple? Use rsplit? Let's use split on " by " and take first part as title, rest as artists.
        parts = entry.split(' by ')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists_str = parts[1].strip()
            # artists separated by comma
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            song_entries.append((title, artists))
print(song_entries)
